method: GitHub repository flags and canonical names came from the GitHub GraphQL API. Repository NOT_FOUND and missing Git objects were confirmed separately using public web responses. Archived software dependencies are excluded; frozen learning material and icon assets may remain. Deprecation findings use explicit owner descriptions.

External links were checked with paced public requests. Missing locations were retried using a browser-style GET and common path corrections. Parked pages were confirmed from their HTML. Timeouts, HTTP 403/429, TLS and DNS failures alone were inconclusive and did not cause removal.

The remaining 33 public GitHub wiki, release, PR and navigation links were checked directly. GitHub Models was retired, the Go Projects wiki lists only successor destinations, and the npm troubleshooting link was repaired with the official Common errors guide.

These are dated findings, not permanent blocklists. Recheck evidence when refreshing this file. Stored URLs in the repair table are the historical link identities so saved resource IDs survive repairs.
